plugins.name: 10x-Team
plugins.description: 10x-Team Skills plugin for Claude Code for building real world application like you build with a team

skills.name: 10x-team
skills.description: You MUST use this when building projects end-to-end. Orchestrates all 12 team roles — automatically switches between CTO, architect, PM, engineers, SRE, security, DBA, QA, and EM based on the current phase of work. Starts with brainstorming before any implementation.
headings: Discovery Protocol — Joining an Existing Project
Phase 0: Brainstorming — Turn Ideas Into Designs
Phase 1: Strategy — Is This Worth Building?
Phase 2: Design — How Should We Build It?
skills.description_zh: 在端到端项目建设中按阶段协调 CTO、架构、产品、开发、运维、安全、数据库、测试和管理等十二种团队角色，并在实现前先开展头脑风暴。

skills.name: cto
skills.description: You MUST use this for strategic technology decisions - build vs buy, architecture direction, resource allocation, technical vision, risk assessment. Evaluates decisions at the intersection of business and technology.
skills.description_zh: 从业务与技术结合的角度评估自研或采购、架构方向、资源分配、技术愿景和风险等战略技术决策。

skills.name: dba
skills.description: You MUST use this for database decisions - schema design, query optimization, migration planning, indexing strategy, data modeling, and database performance issues.
skills.description_zh: 为数据库结构设计、查询优化、迁移计划、索引策略、数据建模和性能问题提供决策指导。

skills.name: devops-engineer
skills.description: You MUST use this for infrastructure and deployment decisions - CI/CD pipelines, containerization, IaC, deployment strategies, environment management, and build automation.
skills.description_zh: 为 CI/CD、容器化、基础设施即代码、部署策略、环境管理和构建自动化提供指导。

skills.name: engineering-manager
skills.description: You MUST use this for team and process decisions - sprint planning, team structure, delivery estimation, process improvements, technical hiring, and engineering team operations.
skills.description_zh: 为迭代计划、团队结构、交付估算、流程改进、技术招聘和工程团队运作提供管理指导。

skills.name: principal-architect
skills.description: You MUST use this for system design and architecture decisions - designing systems, choosing patterns, defining boundaries, data modeling, and making structural decisions that are hard to change later.
headings: Anti-Pattern: "Let Me Just Draw the Boxes"
skills.description_zh: 为系统设计、架构模式选择、边界划分、数据建模及后期难以调整的结构决策提供指导。

skills.name: product-manager
skills.description: You MUST use this for product decisions - feature prioritization, user stories, roadmap planning, requirement gathering, and defining what to build and why.
headings: Anti-Pattern: "Just Build What They Asked For"
skills.description_zh: 帮助确定产品建设的内容与理由，并处理功能优先级、用户故事、路线图和需求收集。

skills.name: qa-engineer
skills.description: You MUST use this for testing and quality decisions - test strategy, test plans, bug analysis, testing frameworks, coverage gaps, and quality assurance processes.
skills.description_zh: 为测试策略、测试计划、缺陷分析、测试框架、覆盖缺口和质量保证流程提供指导。

skills.name: sde
skills.description: You MUST use this for hands-on coding tasks - writing features, fixing bugs, implementing APIs, debugging issues, and writing clean production code.
headings: Anti-Pattern: "Let Me Just Code This Up Real Quick"
skills.description_zh: 执行功能开发、缺陷修复、API 实现和问题调试，并编写清晰的生产代码。

skills.name: security-engineer
skills.description: You MUST use this for security decisions - threat modeling, vulnerability assessment, auth/authz design, security review, compliance requirements, and hardening recommendations.
skills.description_zh: 为威胁建模、漏洞评估、认证与授权设计、安全审查、合规要求和安全加固提供指导。

skills.name: senior-engineer
skills.description: You MUST use this for implementation guidance - code review, design patterns, debugging complex issues, writing production-quality code, and mentoring on engineering best practices.
headings: Anti-Pattern: "I Know the Fix Without Looking"
skills.description_zh: 通过代码审查、设计模式、复杂问题调试和工程实践辅导，指导生产质量代码的实现。

skills.name: sre
skills.description: You MUST use this for reliability and operations decisions - incident response, monitoring, SLOs, capacity planning, performance debugging, and production reliability.
skills.description_zh: 为事故响应、监控、服务等级目标、容量规划、性能调试和生产可靠性提供指导。

skills.name: staff-engineer
skills.description: You MUST use this for cross-cutting technical decisions - code quality standards, cross-team patterns, technical debt strategy, mentoring on complex problems, and driving alignment on engineering practices.
headings: Anti-Pattern: "Let Me Improve This While I'm Here"
skills.description_zh: 处理跨团队技术决策，包括代码质量标准、共享模式、技术债策略、复杂问题辅导和工程实践协调。
